entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's been sitting here for a bit and I just don't want it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF987654321. Look, I don't want to waste time. Your website says 90 days, so just send me the return label and we can be done with this.

One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 17th. So I can document this properly for you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

What does it matter?! I don't like it! It's uncomfortable. This is ridiculous. I am well within the 90-day return window. Are you going to process this return or am I going to have to speak to your manager and write a review about this?
No, that won't be necessary at all, sir. My apologies for the question, it's just a required step for my records. You are absolutely correct, our return policy is indeed 90 days.
So you're going to honor it then?

Yes, of course. You're well within the timeframe. I've just processed the return authorization for you. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and return instructions within the next 10 minutes. Just pack it up and drop it off.
Fine. And I'll get a full refund?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, a full refund will be issued back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
